label: Animals kept on a farm
flavor: The Pantry keeps the ledger of the yard.

traps.note: A henhouse visitor, never a resident.
Wild — it only watches the farm from the treeline.

label: Fruits for the bowl
flavor: Orchard, vine, and bramble all report here.

traps.note: A stalk with ambitions. The Pantry files it under pie.

label: Colors, plain or fancy
flavor: Name a shade; the paint cupboard is deep.

traps.note: All of them at once is not one of them.

label: Weather, of any temper
flavor: The Manor's windows have seen it all.

traps.note: A reply to weather, not weather itself.

label: Something hot in a cup
flavor: Mrs. Bramble insists there is always time.

traps.note: Served cold, on the veranda, in better weather.

label: Vegetables for the pot
flavor: The Pantry is botanically precise, and proud of it.

traps.note: Botanically a berry. The Pantry stands firm.
A fungus keeps its own kingdom.

label: Herbs on the rack
flavor: Leaves only — the Pantry is particular.

traps.note: Bark. The spice shelf is one over.
A root, and it knows it.

label: Musical instruments
flavor: The Music Room lends its inventory.

traps.note: It commands the music but makes none.

label: Trees of the grounds
flavor: Fern the groundskeeper checked this list twice.

traps.note: A grass in a tall coat.

label: Birds of hedge and sky
flavor: The Conservatory windows keep a running list.

traps.note: Leather wings — the belfry's tenant, not a bird.

label: Creatures of the sea
flavor: Salt water only, if you please.

traps.note: The Manor keeps an open mind, and an empty tank.

label: Fabrics in the linen press
flavor: The Linen Closet sends its regards.

traps.note: A hide, not a weave.

label: Flowers for the vase
flavor: Fern grows them; the Pantry names them.

traps.note: Green, graceful, and never once has it flowered.

label: Stones worth setting
flavor: Mined and cut — the jeweler's shelf.

traps.note: Grown, not mined — the oyster's patience.
Old resin with good publicity.

label: Words for rain
flavor: The Manor has needed most of them.

traps.note: The smell after — the Study would like a word with you.

label: Ways to walk
flavor: Steps being the house currency, we collect the verbs.

traps.note: Four legs required.

label: Words for quiet
flavor: Whisper them, naturally.

traps.note: The Pantry trusts you were only testing it.

label: Cheeses under the dome
flavor: The cellar's proudest shelf.

traps.note: Churned, not aged.
A guest from another pantry entirely.

label: Dances from the ballroom
flavor: The floor remembers every one.

traps.note: Music for sitting still.

label: Words for a ghost
flavor: Choose kindly — the Library is listening.

traps.note: Our librarian prefers the word 'resident'.

label: Words for a dwelling
flavor: From hovel to hall, all are homes.

traps.note: For the horses, dear.

label: Shades of red
flavor: The wax cabinet's favorite question.

traps.note: Close to the fire, but its own color.

label: Words for a tiny amount
flavor: A pinch of this, a whisper of that.

traps.note: Generous, but no.

label: Things shelved in the Library
flavor: Ellery drew this list up personally.

traps.note: He does sit on the shelves, granted.
